description: This file contains utility functions for key-value operations in the Superset project, including UUID namespace generation, permalink encoding/decoding, and secure key generation.

methods.name: random_key
methods.description: Generates a secure, random URL-safe string of specified byte length.

methods.name: get_filter
methods.description: Creates a filter dictionary for key-value resource, handling UUID or ID keys.

methods.name: encode_permalink_key
methods.description: Encodes an integer key into a permalink string using hashids with a salt.

methods.name: decode_permalink_id
methods.description: Decodes a permalink string back into an integer ID, raising error if invalid.

methods.name: _uuid_namespace_from_md5
methods.description: Generates a UUID namespace from an MD5 hash of a seed string.

methods.name: _uuid_namespace_from_sha256
methods.description: Generates a UUID namespace from the first 16 bytes of a SHA-256 hash of a seed string.

methods.name: get_uuid_namespace_with_algorithm
methods.description: Generates a UUID namespace using specified hash algorithm ('sha256' or 'md5').

methods.name: get_uuid_namespace
methods.description: Generates a UUID namespace based on app configuration or current app context.

methods.name: get_deterministic_uuid_with_algorithm
methods.description: Creates a deterministic UUID (uuid3) from namespace, payload, and algorithm.

methods.name: get_deterministic_uuid
methods.description: Creates a deterministic UUID (uuid3) from namespace and payload.

methods.name: get_fallback_algorithms
methods.description: Retrieves fallback hash algorithms from app configuration.
